_readme: The machine-checkable half of this project's contract. Enforced by .ironclad/gate.mjs. Loosening anything here requires an ADR stating why (anti-drift M1).
name: foundry-hackathon-gateway

fileSizeExceptions.why: Single-file interactive operator console. Length is menu handlers plus a preflight, each independently readable with no shared state. Splitting it would require dot-sourcing, adding a missing-file failure mode to the one script an organiser runs under time pressure at an event.

boundaries.why: Core logic must stay free of CLI plumbing so it remains unit-testable.

secretAllowlist.why: Test fixtures use obviously fake signing secrets, never real credentials.
